column1: # Org area -> khal calendar, one calendar per top-level directory under
# ~/.local/share/orgmode, so every area is its own layer on the phone.
# First column: directory name. Second: khal calendar name (the name Google
# shows as well). Areas without a row fall back to `gcal`.
# Adding an area: create the Google calendar, add its ID to [pair gcal] in
# then add the row below. nvim and orgpush both read this file.
